scripts.codegen:native: cargo run -q -p bffi-example-native --bin emit-json && bun bin/index.ts codegen examples/native/js/bffi.api.json -o examples/native/js/api.gen.ts --runtime ../../../packages/bffi-loader/src/index.ts
scripts.test:native: bun run build && bun run codegen:native && bun test js && BFFI_SEQUENTIAL_E2E=1 bun test generated-sequential
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && cargo check --workspace
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run fmt:check && bun run clippy && bun run test
